// RED fixture — `no-permissive-authorizer-in-prod` (R2.6).
// A production composition root constructing the permissive allow-everything authorizer fixtures
// OUTSIDE any test gate: the action-level `AllowAll` handed to the gateway builder, and the
// per-repo `AllowAllRepos` wired as a backend default. Both must fire.

fn boot_edge() {
    let gateway = Gateway::builder(authn, human_login, Arc::new(AllowAll))
        .route(Method::Get, "/v1/whoami", "edge.whoami", Arc::new(WhoamiHandler))
        .build();
    serve(gateway);
}

fn rooted_backend() -> DurableGitBackend {
    DurableGitBackend {
        repo_authz: Arc::new(AllowAllRepos),
        bootstrap: Arc::new(NoRepoBootstrap),
    }
}
